name: course-builder
description: Reusable Claude Code plugin that turns a module.spec.yaml into a full course-module artifact bundle (ementa, student git repo with planted verified bugs, lesson plans, Gamma slide instructions, 1st-person instructor scripts, HTML portal) by orchestrating 9 subagents, 2 skills and 2 PreToolUse hooks via the /course-builder:build-module command. Components in commands/, agents/, skills/ and hooks/hooks.json are auto-discovered.
